ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a light green trapezoid, with the upper base labeled 19 in. Two pink dashed lines indicate the perpendicular heights from the two ends of the upper base down to the bottom base, and the height is labeled 20 in in the figure. The bottom base is longer than the upper base, extending 2 in more on the left side and 10 in more on the right side. Reasoning: Treat the whole figure as a trapezoid. Upper base b1 = 19 in; the lower base consists of 2 in on the left, 19 in corresponding to the upper base, and 10 in on the right, so b2 = 2 + 19 + 10 = 31 in. The trapezoid area formula is A = 1/2(b1 + b2)h, so A = 1/2(19 + 31)(20) = 1/2(50)(20) = 500. No rounding is needed.
